use generated_dmn::{Value, evaluate};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
fn number(coefficient: &str, scale: i32) -> Value {
    Value::Number {
        coefficient: coefficient.into(),
        scale,
    }
}
fn encode(value: &Value) -> String {
    match value {
        Value::Null => "N".into(),
        Value::Boolean(true) => "T".into(),
        Value::Boolean(false) => "F".into(),
        Value::Number { coefficient, scale } => format!("D{coefficient},{scale}"),
        Value::List(values) => format!(
            "[{}]",
            values.iter().map(encode).collect::<Vec<_>>().join("|")
        ),
        _ => panic!("unexpected builtin result"),
    }
}
#[test]
fn builtins_match_java_with_unicode_nulls_and_exact_decimals() {
    const NS: &str = "urn:rust-proof:builtins";
    let numbers = [
        Value::Null,
        number("-12500", 3),
        number("0", 3),
        number("-1", -12),
        number("-1", 4096),
        number(&format!("-{}", "9".repeat(4096)), 0),
    ];
    let texts = [
        None,
        Some(""),
        Some("A\u{1f30d}e\u{301}"),
        Some("\u{df}\u{1d11e}"),
        Some("ababa"),
        Some("\u{4f60}\u{597d}"),
    ];
    let needles = [
        None,
        Some(""),
        Some("\u{1f30d}"),
        Some("a"),
        Some("e\u{301}"),
        Some("\u{754c}"),
    ];
    let text = |s: Option<&str>| s.map_or(Value::Null, |s| Value::Text(s.into()));
    let mut count = 0;
    for line in include_str!("builtin_vectors.tsv").lines() {
        let columns: Vec<_> = line.split('\t').collect();
        let n: usize = columns[0].parse().unwrap();
        let t: usize = columns[1].parse().unwrap();
        let k: usize = columns[2].parse().unwrap();
        let values = evaluate(&BTreeMap::from([
            ((NS, "number"), numbers[n].clone()),
            ((NS, "text"), text(texts[t])),
            ((NS, "needle"), text(needles[k])),
        ]))
        .unwrap();
        let actual = values
            .iter()
            .map(|((_, id), v)| format!("{id}={}", encode(v)))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join(";");
        assert_eq!(actual, columns[3], "vector {n}/{t}/{k}");
        count += 1;
    }
    assert_eq!(count, 216);
}
